transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
I came in because I can’t make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street anymore. I keep finding excuses to stay in the back, even though working up front is part of my job.
What specifically worries you or goes through your mind when you approach the front windows or that street?

I just… I can’t make myself go near them. When I get close to the front windows or that part of the street, I want to turn around and stay in the back. I keep coming up with reasons not to work up front, even though I’m supposed to.
Did something happen near the front windows or on that street that triggered this fear?
I don’t know… I just know I can’t bring myself to go near the front windows or that stretch of street now. I keep staying in the back and making excuses not to work up front.
Do you ever have unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares related to that area popping into your mind?
Yeah. The crash just pops into my head out of nowhere, especially when I’m setting up displays. I’ll suddenly hear the bang and see the glass coming down, like it’s happening again.
How long ago did the crash happen?
About two weeks ago—ever since that car crashed through the store window during my overnight shift.
